title: ‘The Life and Deaths of Wilson Shedd’ Review: Amanda Seyfried Falls for a Convicted Killer in Tim Blake Nelson’s Sad and Sober Death Penalty Drama
summary: TIFF: Scoot McNairy seduces his prison writing teacher in a true-life drama with no easy answers.

title: ‘All That She Wants’ Review: It’s Time to Welcome Annie Murphy to the Rom-Com Queen Club
summary: TIFF: Filmmakers (and real-life spouses) Scarlett Bermingham and Andrew Rhymer direct Murphy and Cooper Raiff in a warm rom-com about generational disconnect, real chemistry, and hard choices. It's adorable.

title: ‘Love of Your Life’ Review: Margaret Qualley Plays a Woman Adrift in the Kind of Lush and Tender Romantic Drama Hollywood Rarely Makes Anymore
summary: TIFF: Rachel Morrison's second feature stars Margaret Qualley as a Boston nurse who beautifully crashes out after her marriage dies.

title: ‘Lanterns’ Review: Episode 5 Lights Up Rushville with a Sh*tstorm of Consequences — Spoilers
summary: Hal's recklessness finally catches up to him, John's dubiousness pays hard-won dividends, and one case comes to a definitive, devastating end — leaving three full episodes to address that other investigation.

title: ‘How We Stand’ Review: Amber Midthunder Stars in a Richly Drawn, Magical-Realist Indigenous Tale
summary: TIFF: Marie Clements' "How We Stand" ambitiously seeks to examine hidden and violent sociopolitical aspects of recent Indigenous history through a deeply personal lens.

title: Why Do Men Keep Telling Anna Biller She’s ‘Camp’?
summary: TIFF: After nearly quitting filmmaking, "The Love Witch" director returns with "The Face of Horror" — and tells IndieWire why she believes her bloody medieval tragedy is already being misunderstood.

title: ‘The Uprising’ Bombs at Box Office Despite Last-Ditch Scramble to Market Film as Robin Hood Origin Story
summary: Paul Greengrass's historical epic opens with an anemic $3.25 million, becoming the latest film about the outlaw to fall flat.

title: From Tragedy to ‘Everest’: Inside Jimmy Chin and Chai Vasarhelyi’s Most Ambitious Film Yet
summary: Summiting the North Side of Everest and skiing down was a feat. So was filming it. In the NatGeo documentary "Everest: The Other Side," we not only witness ski-mountaineer Jim Morrison's athletic heroism, but also Jimmy Chin's filmmaking prowess. This could be an Oscar contender.

title: ‘I Play Rocky’ Review: Sylvester Stallone’s Wild Hollywood Underdog Story Gets a Punchy Crowdpleaser
summary: TIFF: Peter Farrelly continues his reign of making audience-delighting hits for the TIFF crowd, but this one pulls its punches a bit.

title: ‘Mr. Irrelevant’ Trailer: David Corenswet Toughs and Smiles His Way to the NFL as Last Draft Pick John Tuggle
summary: Jonathan Levine directs the inspiring sports story that opens in theaters from Paramount and Skydance Sports on Christmas Day.

title: ‘Practical Magic 2,’ the Sequel to a 28-Year-Old Box Office Bomb, Opens to Lackluster $30 Million
summary: Hey Hollywood, stop giving us sequels we didn't ask for to movies that opened way too long ago for us to care.

title: How Susanna White Brought Lauded One-Woman Play ‘Prima Facie’ to the Big Screen (Casting Cynthia Erivo Helped)
summary: TIFF: The director tells IndieWire that turning the celebrated one-woman play into a feature film with multiple locations, characters, and some extremely demanding scenes was exactly the kind of challenge she loves. Plus: a major star.
